style: Use case: illustration-story / scientific-educational. ONE children's science picture book illustration, landscape aspect 1216:832. Warm watercolor and colored pencils on fine cream paper, friendly refined rounded shapes, clear educational detail and believable construction, age 4-8. No text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermarks or panel borders. Leave important objects comfortably inside margins. No baked-in arrows; all labels and arrows are added separately by the website.
scenes: Cover: elegant WHITE Chinese-style high-speed electric train with thin cobalt blue side stripe, long rounded aerodynamic nose pointing toward right foreground. Racing on correctly aligned two steel rails on a viaduct over green fields, overhead electric wire and raised pantograph contact visible, bright blue sky. Bogies and wheels on rails, no steam or exhaust, no logo.

Wide three-quarter station arrival scene: same white-blue train stationary beside clean platform, door OPEN at platform height. Parents and children waiting safely behind yellow line away from track, orderly boarding beside open door. Modern airy station roof and platform visible. Whole front carriage fits frame, no person on rails.

Close three-quarter front aerodynamic nose study: long smooth white-blue bullet-like nose fills center, dark cab window upper-right, gentle translucent curved AIR ribbons flowing smoothly around nose, no arrows or lightning, no facial features. Track below and simple pale blue background; complete nose tip clearly visible not cropped.

Interior long carriage from front down aisle: comfortable blue paired seats, families seated and looking through large rectangular windows at green fields. Clear connected corridor beyond inner door, overhead luggage racks, calm bright clean carriage. No passengers outside, no steering wheel in passenger area. Floor continuous with aisle uncluttered.

Low track-focused perspective: TWO continuous parallel steel rails with concrete sleepers on smooth slab, converge into distance through green cultivated fields. White-blue highspeed train in middle distance wheels correctly aligned on SAME rails. Overhead wire masts along track. No third rail splitting under wheels, no track floating in air.

Roof-level engineering closeup: single raised articulated black pantograph on top of white-blue train; its narrow horizontal carbon contact strip PHYSICALLY TOUCHES one overhead contact wire at upper-center. Visible joints form hinged Z geometry with base bolted to roof below. Blue sky behind, distant masts. No electric sparks, no gap at contact, no decorative antennas.

Underfloor traction closeup cutaway: steel wheel pair seated on two rails, compact electric motor and gearbox mounted on bogie adjacent to axle, cable comes from underfloor electrical equipment. White-blue train body above, distant tunnel mouth softly behind. A small isolated stylized golden electrical-energy glow near cable (not lightning hitting train), no huge lightning bolt; clear mechanical motor-wheel connection.

Very wide green valley: long level elevated railway viaduct spans blue river on solid concrete piers. Same white-blue train atop bridge, rails and overhead wires follow bridge and enter TUNNEL in mountain at far-right. River flows visibly beneath, landscape calm and realistic, bridge complete load path, no wheels leaving rails.

Mountain cutaway landscape: white-blue high-speed train on rails enters a dark arched railway tunnel at center-left, tunnel passes THROUGH a mountain shown with small geological cutaway section revealing interior passage. Mountain peaks above, rails continue into tunnel, overhead electrical line supported safely. Bright outside and darker inside, no fantastical cavern.

Driver cabin closeup from rear-left: adult uniformed driver seated left facing track, hands near appropriate control lever on blue-gray control console, colored simple unlettered screens and buttons; broad FRONT WINDOW upper-right shows twin rails and overhead wire aligned ahead. Real train controller not car steering wheel, alert upright posture.

Speed scene: white-blue high-speed train foreground sweeping past green fields on rails, overhead catenary; soft directional motion blur only on landscape, crisp train. One unlettered semicircular speed gauge pictogram upper-left with needle near high end for separate numeric website overlay. Puffy cloud upper-right. No racing cars on railway, no baked-in digits or arrows.

Recap panoramic scene: white-blue high-speed train travels on level bridge over green river valley, large clearly visible pantograph touches wire on roof. Include a tasteful small detached closeup study of pantograph upper-left on pale sky region, no panel border. Bridge piers and rails correctly support train, distant tunnel optional. No labels, no text.
